pages.text: The polarizer magnetizes items. Its main job is turning $(item)magnetic alloy ingots$() into $(item)magnets$(), one at a time. Right-click it with an item to insert it, with an empty hand to take it out, or feed it with funnels and chutes.

$(l)Power$()$(li)It connects through its $(item)back$() face.$(li)While working it is a $(item)30 ohm$() consumer and needs at least $(item)2,000 W$(), which means about $(item)245 V$() or more.$(li)A single generator reaches that above roughly 215 RPM.$(br2)Below 2,000 W, goggles show a red $(item)not enough power$() line and the charge does not move.

$(l)Cycle$()$(br)It charges for $(item)10 seconds$(), then the item is converted with a burst of sparks. Its goggle tooltip shows the charge.$(br2)Before you have a polarizer, see $(item)The first magnet$() in the $(item)Making Power$() chapter for the hand recipe.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
